research.hook: College projects aur placement tension? Yeh 4 AI tools tumhara 80% kaam bilkul free mein kar denge! 🚀

Gamma AI: Create professional assignment presentation slides in under 3 minutes with automated formatting.
Canva Magic Studio: Design eye-catching graphics for college fest posters and LinkedIn profile banners.

carousel_outline: Slide 1: Salary aati hai aur 5 din mein gayab? 💸 4 simple rules to fix your weekend spending trap.
Slide 2: Rule 1: The '24-Hour Wait' Rule. Swiggy/Zomato cart ya online sale items ko 24 ghante ke liye hold par rakho. 80% impulse buys naturally drop ho jaayenge.
Slide 3: Rule 2: Auto-SIP on Payday. Salary credit hote hi pehle savings kattni chahiye, baad mein party expenses. Pay yourself first!
Slide 4: Rule 3: Separate 'Chill Wallet' vs 'Bill Wallet'. Keep rent/bills in one account and a set UPI weekly limit for daily chai, meals, and outings.
Slide 5: Rule 4: The Unused Subscription Audit. Check those ₹199-₹299 recurring debits for apps you haven't opened in months.
Slide 6: Save this post for payday! Comment 'BUDGET' below and we'll send you our free expense tracker sheet. 📊
